verdicts.reason: Both break the original the same way. 'NEW YORK' has lost its navy ribbon and now sits as bare white serif text on the busy photo. An empty navy stub floats above it, the 'SUBWAY' and 'GUIDE' ribbons are tiny next to it, and the grey diagonal panels have broken into stray fragments. A also leaves a dead band of photo above the title group, and its fragments look like glitches near the bottom. B anchors the title block at the top, which reads better for a tall skyscraper banner, but it crowds the empty bar against the title and leaves the same stray shards mid-canvas, so it is only slightly less bad.
